feed.title: Google Cloud: Cloud Vision
feed.subtitle: Changelog for Google Cloud product: Cloud Vision

entry.content:
Face detection model update

The emotion label response in the Cloud Vision API is deprecated. Going forward, the Cloud Vision API face detection (FACE_DETECTION feature) will return UNKNOWN for all emotion-related labels.
entry.summary: The emotion labels in the face detection feature of the Cloud Vision API are now deprecated. Future responses will return 'UNKNOWN' for all emotion-related labels.
entry.title: Deprecated: Emotion labels deprecated
